Episode 170. Meeting Another Friend, Dante (4)
'Seven.'
Despite several tragedies, Dante had taken absolute power of the empire at a very fast pace over the past three years.
Power gained so quickly is usually precarious.
But, with only seven traitors, it was a testament to how well Dante and his advisor Kashmir had been doing.
Yuria marked the personnel on the pre-drawn layout of the vassals and handed it to Dante.
'Three rank 10 vassals, three rank 7, one rank 5?'
He glanced sideways to check the location of the traitors.
'They're too minor to plot the assassination of the Empire's regent.'
At first glance, they were all people he didn't even know by face. They weren't nobles, nor did they have outstanding abilities. They were just ordinary vassals.
Dante also had the same question. There was nothing immediately obvious they could do to assassinate him.
However, outward status and abilities can change at any time. That's what Zephyrin was, and it was uncertain how the chaos control of the prophet could transform a person.
"Well, everyone must be too busy to dare betraying."
Quite a few vassals spat out profanity under their breath at that comment, but the liars weren't included.
The silence continued.
Even when Yuria confirmed the liars, the chamber was quiet for nearly 10 minutes, and the vassals didn't understand why Dante was doing this.
After a long contemplation, Dante turned his head as if he could do nothing and looked at Jin.
He gestured for him to come closer and lend his ear.
'Why?'
'I know that those seven could be traitors, but how should I ask the next question?'
'Why have you become stupid while I haven't seen you? You call that a question?'
'I'm naturally a bit slow.'

'I should have properly prepared a list of questions in advance. There's no need to worry, Dante. Ask if there's someone who has passed information to Runcandel. Then it becomes clear whether they just have different intentions or they betrayed.'
'Oh, I see.'
Dante cleared his throat.
"Hmm! As there aren't many questions left, you all have to understand my atrocious behavior."
"No!"
"No!"
Yuria thought about marking the list of liars too, but gave up because it was too many.
"Is there anyone among those present who has informed either the Sword Garden or the Empire?"
Of course, the answer was no. But the seven who were initially caught by the power of truth were still lying.
Soon, Jin could see why the Sword Garden had attracted such ordinary people.
'An Imperial Palace entrant. Unless the Prophet gave them special abilities, it means only the entrants to the Imperial Palace were needed.'
The reason for needing the Imperial Palace entrants was clear.
The internal structure.
Vermont's Imperial Palace was the largest external building in the world, and internally it had the most complex structure.
Especially, the secret areas like the Emperor's residence and the underground passages, which were not open to the public, were mostly unknown to other major powers.
'The confirmed seven traitors are also composed of lower and middle ranks, so they don't know all those areas either.'
It's natural that parts that forces like Runcandel, Zephyr, and Nameless have failed to find out despite planting numerous spies in the royal family over a long time.
Furthermore, the locations of the secret areas of the royal family would change irregularly.
So why them?
Jin made an assumption.

'The underground tunnel that the Prophet created in the Sota desert in the past... What if the help of a royal palace entrant was needed to create that? Even if they don't need very detailed information about the secret areas, they might need a rough structure of the inside of the Imperial Palace.'
Even assuming so, there was still a question.
Dante had often gone on missions alone in the contaminated area, so if they were going to assassinate him, such a moment would be more appropriate.
'It's fine to find out why they chose the Imperial Palace instead of when he was on a solo mission.'
First, they needed to confirm what information they had passed on, and if the guess was correct.
'Jin.'
'Finally, ask if anyone has received chaos or other special abilities.'
Dante nods his head.
"Last question. Among the vassals gathered here, has anyone received chaos or other special abilities?"
"No!"
This time, no one was lying.
This meant that even the traitors did not receive the power of chaos.
Then, even if they caught them right away, there would be no other casualties.
'Arrest the relevant personnel.'
As Jin whispered, Dante bulged his eyes and revealed his suppressed anger.
"Hairan!"
"Command me, Master!"
"Kimar Rights, Julian Rights, Edmund Kel, Dbara Roskella, Bernard Quian, Killian Knash, Atta Boyn. Arrest these seven immediately."
The elites of Hairan present at the meeting arrested them even before 15 seconds passed.
The vassals were astonished by what happened out of the blue.
They saw the sudden summons and the arrest of those nobodies as a form of creating a sense of fear.
Or even thought that Dante, finally revealing his grudge against Ron, has transformed into a tyrant.
"Your Majesty! Why are you doing this?"
"Your Majesty, why us..."
"So that the other vassals don't misunderstand, I will reveal my truth. The person standing behind me right now is the princess of the Free Nation Tikan, and a contractor of Az Mil."
Exclamations flowed out from all around.
If the disguised girl was Yuria Alphrion, the identity of the man who was whispering with the regent was obvious as fire.
Now there was no reason to hide their identity.

"This is Jin Runcandel from the Vamel Federation. According to what our Federation's spies have discovered, the royal family betrayed Zephyr and joined the Sword Garden. So we had to urgently find out if there was a collaborator with the Sword Garden within the Empire."
The arrested traitors were made to kneel before Dante.
After Dante covered Yuria's eyes, he drew his sword and struck one of their throats.
Thick fresh blood instantly stained the golden floor with red.
"He, hek."
"It's, it's a misunderstanding. I didn't, didn't betray..."
"Shut up. The one who died painlessly just now was just lucky. You are unlucky."
The traitors looked around trembling.
Not only Dante and Jin's party, but even the vassals who were full of anger and hatred due to the brutal workload under the regent were glaring at them as if they were going to kill them.
Even though they may not like Dante, it was a fact that all the vassals gathered here were dedicating their lives to the empire.
Everyone felt a great pride that the capital of the empire is still intact in this era of chaos, and thought there was no better way to serve the empire than Dante's method.
But those traitors were trying to ruin all that.
"If you want to get rid of at least a little bit of your misfortune, it would be good to answer the truth in detail to what I'm going to ask now."
At Dante's signal, the servants swiftly cleaned up the corpse and blood. When Yuria opened her eyes again, seeing only six people left, she thought Dante surprisingly had a ruthless force.
"First, what promise did you receive from the Sword Garden?"
Jin anticipated it would be immortality. As foolish ones like the elders of Barton or Seigalga did in the past.
"...Survival."
One of the traitors met Dante's eyes.
He had the most serene eyes among the remaining six.
Only he was prepared for such a day to come.
"Survival?"

"Your Highness... We have met Lord Rosa personally. It was a meeting through a kind of crystal ball, but we faced the power of Runcandel directly in conversation with him. He said he would destroy the whole world except for Hupester."
"So you decided to betray me, to live a miserable life under Rosa, abandoning the empire which will soon perish?"
"If you truly care for the empire, you should surrender to Lord Rosa now. Although I am a traitor, this is the last straightforward advice I can give you."
According to Yuria, the traitors, including him, sincerely thought so.
They say that even if the empire and the whole world combined their power, they wouldn't be able to handle Rosa.
"I won't blame you for your weak choices. Therefore, you should also accept the punishment that will befall you with serenity."
"You are planning to exterminate our entire clan."
"Everything that exists in your clans will be erased from this world. But if you confess the information you provided to Rosa, I will spare the children and innocent servants."
Yuria proved that Dante's words were true by presenting a blue ribbon.
The traitor who was in conversation with Dante nodded his head.
"We lower-class vassals have little information, Your Majesty. The information we provided to Lord Rosa is, I swear, entirely about the interior structure of the Imperial Palace."
At that point, Jin recalled the prophet's burrow once again.
"Didn't he explain what he would do with that information?"
"That's correct."
It was true. As Jin expected, they had no information to inform Runcandel of, other than a rough structure of the Imperial Palace.
In fact, Rosa didn't even ask them for any other information.
"I'll keep my promise. Take them away."
"Yes, Your Highness!"
As the vassals watched the traitors being taken away, every one of them had a face twisted with anger.
It wasn't anger towards Dante, but towards Rosa and the Sword Garden.
Jin stepped forward.

"The prophet in the Sword Garden has the ability to create special burrows. It's highly likely that he received the interior structure of the Imperial Palace from the traitors to make that. Perhaps they were not just trying to assassinate the regent, but they might have planned to invade the Imperial Palace through a burrow."
Therefore, what needs to be done now is to check whether a burrow is already being formed inside the Imperial Palace.
Dante, had already thought of a way to do that.
"We will break down the Imperial Palace to find it. It's full of nothing but symbols of the vanished royal family, so there won't be much to regret. Start immediately, you should get ready."
